coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Mission Bay Commons
record.summary: A roughly two-acre lawn and green space at 3rd Street and Mission Bay Boulevard in Mission Bay, part of the city's Mission Bay Parks system; the San Francisco Recreation and Park Department took over its management and maintenance from OCII/the Port on July 1, 2023. No source checked gives this lawn's own original construction or opening date.

notes.accuracy_caveat: HIGH CONFIDENCE -- real, community-surveyed OSM polygon tagged with the Mission Bay Parks system's own missionbayparks.com URL for this facility. Covers only this one mapped lot (roughly the Mission Bay Blvd. lawn/plaza between the Radiance and Nektar/Bayer buildings); the wider Mission Bay Commons interim-use area further west (Spark Social SF, Stagecoach Greens, the soccer field) is a separate, still-interim installation tracked as its own record below (Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons interim area) pending the Future Parks Project's 2028-2030 construction.

open_questions: No independently dated source found for when this lawn (the single mapped OSM lot between the Radiance and Nektar/Bayer buildings, per this record's own geometry file) was built or opened. The only dated event found is SF Rec & Park's July 1, 2023 assumption of management from OCII, which is a management transfer, not a construction-completion date -- not used as a completion milestone, per this repo's rule against attributing an area-wide/administrative event to an individual record's build status.

This record's geometry file explicitly distinguishes this single mapped lawn from the much larger, still-interim 'Mission Bay Commons' area further west (Spark Social SF, Stagecoach Greens, the soccer field, tracked separately as mission_bay_commons_interim_west); OCII's own Nov 2024 CAC materials use the plan labels P11, P12, P13, P15, P16 and P17 for that wider interim-use area collectively, without singling out which label (if any) corresponds to this specific mapped lot -- not resolved here.
